description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Server_System, which provides XML-RPC system methods such as listing methods, getting method help, signatures, and multicall functionality within the Zend Framework's XML-RPC server component.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Server_System
classes.description: Provides system-level XML-RPC methods such as listing available methods, method help, signatures, and multicall support.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Returns an array of all available XML-RPC methods.

methods.name: methodHelp
methods.description: Returns help information for a specified XML-RPC method.

methods.name: methodSignature
methods.description: Returns the signature (prototypes) of a specified method.

methods.name: multicall
methods.description: Executes multiple method calls in a single request, returning responses or faults.
